whenToUse: Use designsetgo/card for a self-contained content unit with an optional image, badge, title, subtitle, body copy, and a single CTA — pricing tiers, feature highlights, team member bios, or product summaries. Cards are commonly repeated inside a designsetgo/grid or designsetgo/row, but they also work standalone.
avoid: Do not leave the CTA area's innerBlocks empty when showCta is true — designsetgo/card only accepts designsetgo/icon-button there, so include one, or set showCta to false if the card has no action.
Do not put anything other than designsetgo/icon-button in the card's innerBlocks — it's the only block the CTA area accepts.
Do not set title/subtitle/bodyText to empty strings while leaving the corresponding show* toggle (showTitle/showSubtitle/showBody) true — that renders an empty heading/paragraph element.
Do not forget imageAlt when showImage is true and imageUrl is set — the image needs accessible alt text just like core/image.
